blurb: Frontier and industrial research labs, with parent organisation, leadership, funding model, and published work.

reading.body:
The dataset for this category currently contains a single entry: the Allen Institute for AI, a non-profit research institute founded in 2014.

Ai2 sits outside the for-profit lab structure that dominates most public discussion of frontier AI. Its non-profit funding model separates it from the capital-intensive scaling races that require continuous equity raises to pay for compute and power infrastructure. Whether that model constrains or insulates its research agenda is a question the data does not answer.

The dataset covers one organization out of a research-lab landscape that, by any reasonable count, includes many more. It records founding status, funding model, and source verification, but contains no information on compute access, published output volume, or infrastructure footprint. Readers should treat this as a starting point rather than a representative sample.
